## F — Research index and VERIFY list: Vehicle preparation, restraint use and traffic-stop procedure
Knowledge index: part C contains 49 original fact blocks across 1 chunks; part C2 contains 37 continuation fact blocks across 1 chunks, all from this section’s mapped physical pages.
Authority and exam facts are located in A.01; audience in B.01; accuracy limits in D.01; demand and competitor gaps in E.01 and E2.01.
VERIFY list:
Accepted inventory: 49 C facts; 37 C2 facts; 13 typed debts; ids DE-PREPARATION-COUNT, DE-PREPARATION-PASS, DE-PREPARATION-TIME, DE-PREPARATION-CADENCE, DE-PREPARATION-COVER, DE-PREPARATION-CHILD-LEGAL, DE-PREPARATION-STOP-RIGHTS, DE-PREPARATION-TIRE, DE-PREPARATION-AIRBAG, DE-PREPARATION-IMPACT, DE-PREPARATION-VISUAL, DE-PREPARATION-MARKET, DE-PREPARATION-TEARDOWN.
- DE-PREPARATION-COUNT: The handbook does not state the knowledge-test question count; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a count.
- DE-PREPARATION-PASS: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test passing percentage or passing score; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a threshold.
- DE-PREPARATION-TIME: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test time limit; do not substitute the road-exam duration.
- DE-PREPARATION-CADENCE: The snapshot is dated July on the front cover; the frequency of handbook revision was not independently verified.
- DE-PREPARATION-COVER: The extracted cover text carries the edition but not the graphical title or issuer; the issuer is established separately by frontmatter and the official linking page.
- DE-PREPARATION-CHILD-LEGAL: The child-seat legal list joins age and weight with AND, and its later belt and front-seat clauses include manufacturer limits and unreproduced statutory exceptions. Exact threshold logic and current applicability require legal review before instructional rules are minted.
- DE-PREPARATION-STOP-RIGHTS: The traffic-stop rights passage makes broad claims about information duties, passenger compliance, searches, detention duration and access to counsel. These legal claims are withheld pending qualified review and current statutory verification.
- DE-PREPARATION-TIRE: The tire-pressure passage lists both the vehicle manual and tire sidewall without distinguishing recommended inflation from a tire rating. Do not teach a sidewall value as universally recommended pressure.
- DE-PREPARATION-AIRBAG: The airbag discussion uses broad side-impact, rear-impact and rollover wording after describing frontal impacts. Do not generalize this as the capability of every airbag system; equipment-specific guidance needs verification.
- DE-PREPARATION-IMPACT: The load example asserts a fixed impact force from mass and road speed without stating stopping time or distance. That numerical example and the similar bracing analogy are not minted as physical facts.
- DE-PREPARATION-VISUAL: Seat, restraint and steering illustrations have not been visually checked. Image-dependent fit, position or maneuver practice needs source-image validation.
- DE-PREPARATION-MARKET: market pack requires sourced recon.
- DE-PREPARATION-TEARDOWN: competitive teardown requires sourced inspection.
Dynamic isolation: Contact details and mutable service/provider information remain outside stable facts; monetary and numerical rules are stated only as source-edition facts.

corpus_stability.reason: Working assessment from a single dated official handbook snapshot; actual revision frequency remains unverified debt in part A.
